text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (January 09, 2026) for 1016 O'Connor Drive, 2

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order, (January 9, 2026), for 1016 O'Connor Drive, 2, Folder No. 26 100208 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to May 31, 2027.
